source: 2016/TSB Vol 16 No 02 - New GM 6L80 Fill Plug adapter.pdf
title: GM ATF Fill Plug Adapter
lead: MOC has developed a new transmission adapter (Part No. 94922) for use on GM 6L80 transmissions with a fill plug. This adapter can be used with the adapter connected to the line pressure port (Part No. 94796).
parts: Adapter, ATF Pressure Port, 1/8" NPT Hose
